**Chapter V8 - Data Protection** 

This chapter was perfect in many ways! No revisions/changes from my end except some of the below mentioned where we need some consistency. 

Here are a few things I observed reviewing this chapter for v.5.0 for sanity check related to #2582: 

_V8.1 General Data Protection_
Needs some paragraph describing this section. For consistency across all subsections in ASVS.

_V8.2 Client-side Data Protection_
Needs some paragraph describing this section. For consistency across all subsections in ASVS.
